comments:
6ad300e2: 
;This routine handles saving data to the VISTA DATA ENTRY CODES file (#393)
;and setting the audit trail cross-reference
1fafbea0: ;Call the ^DIE entry point to edit the VISTA DATA ENTRY CODES file
9a6e8e99: ;Initialize variables used by ^DIE
648fe8ac: ;If the DT node exists, set DE(1) to the 5th piece (last edited date/time)
3e781027: ;Clean up temporary variables
e7d2c77f: Write device header and prompt.
3fd42039: Quit.
ce191f1f: Write prompt and go to new line if needed.
40203be7: If response text is too long, if DV parameter is not present, or if DV parameter indicates free text or key word input, branch to RW^DIR2.
3a45118f: If there is a response and DV is not present, or DV indicates internal coding and help frames exist, display the 'No Editing' message.
4c6ffc5b: Read response with timeout, set DTOUT if timed out, and sound bell for invalid input.
d56bf464: Quit.
db688dfc: Increment the value of DQ (data qualifier) by 1
514bbdf9: Branch to the line indicated by the current value of DQ
6541d4e4: Go to label PR if DE(DQ) is defined, otherwise execute W and TR
e4252be0: If X is null, go to label A if DV doesn't contain 'R', go to label X if DV is null, go to label X if D is non-positive, otherwise go to label A
8ba88d47: If X starts with '?', go to label QS, else if X starts with '^', execute D and branch to ^DIE17
e4f4d019: If X is '@', execute D and branch to Z^DIE2
fa4b592b: If X is ' ' and DV contains 'd' but not 'P', and ^DISV(DUZ,'DIE',DLB) is defined, set X to the value at ^(DLB). If DV doesn't contain 'D' or 'S', write '  '_X

cf3d64d9: If DV is truth-valued, go to M^DIE17. If DV contains 'V', go to ^DIE3. If DV doesn't contain 'S', go to label P. Execute code from ^DD(DP,DIFLD,12.1) if defined. Set % to the portion after the first ';'_X_':' in DU. Set Y=X. If % is non-null, execute DIC('S') if defined. If no DB(DQ) is defined, write '  '_%. Go to label V.

b7e13476: Loop through each ';' piece of DU. Set Y to the piece, DG to the piece position of ':'_X within Y. If Y is null, go to X. Set YS=Y, set Y to the portion before the first ':'. If DG is truth-valued, execute DIC('S') if defined. Quit the loop if DG is truth-valued.
c99bc3eb: If no DB(DQ) is defined, write from position DG to the end of YS. Set X to the portion of YS before the first ':'.
4cd0ac62: If the lookup value is less than 0, quit.
5f20d47e: If the data value does not need a number transform and has more than 24 decimal digits, delete the value.
9e5267d5: If the data value needs a number transform, remove leading and trailing zeros and decimal points.
80c0d498: Perform the INPUT transform on the data value.
49d652f9: If the data value is not null, store it in the global array for the current field. If the field is audited, store the data value for the audit trail.
6c01f7d5: If the Database (DB) array contains an entry for the current Data Qualifier (DQ), jump to the ^DIE17 routine at the 'Z' label.
650f87d5: Set the variable X to the string '?BAD'.
ed876a4b: Set the variable DZ to the value of X, execute the 'D' label, execute the 'QQ^DIEQ' routine, and then jump to the 'B' label.

801e4858: Set the variable D to the value of DIFLD (Data Field). Set the DQ(DQ) array entry to a string consisting of DLB (Data Label), U (Uppercase), DV (Data Value), U, DU (Data User), U, DW (Data Write), U, and the second through last pieces of the $TEXT function applied to X_DQ.

8e880463: If the DE (Data Element) array does not contain an entry for the current DQ, execute the 'O' label and jump to the 'RD' label if X is not equal to '@', jump to the 'A' label if DV does not contain 'R' and X is equal to '@', or jump to the 'X' label if X is equal to '@'. Otherwise, set X to the value of Y and jump to the 'N' label.

39157ea2: Set the variable DG to the value of DV, set the variable Y to the value of DE(DQ), and set the variable X to the value of DU. If the DQ(DQ,2) array entry exists, execute the code stored in that array entry. Then, jump to the 'RP' label.
62858dda: If starting with 'P', retrieve field from 'parent' file.
c5661acf: If starting with 'V', retrieve field from 'multiple' file.
2e9e6551: If starting with 'D', execute CODE stored in ^DD global. If starting with 'S', retrieve data from 'specifier'.
fce7de78: If setting DATEJXA field with type DATE check if data is valid and required.
417eda61: If input is not allowed with @internal or #internal identifier, go to reader program.
6d72b00d: If error trap is set then go to reader program, else process data.
fadb190c: Exit the input transform.
b73daf7a: Set name of field, sequence number.
05d8d0cf: Set date word, external date format, up-arrow computations, label of field, field number.
5c592aa3: Go to reader program.
71625bb3: Prompt for date using ^%DT and default to current date.
83f12f3e: Exit the transform.
5389a55f: If data is altered, re-index cross-references. Get external format of data, set DIC(0) node and word processing flags for reader program, then go to reader program to process data.
06c06e68: Set status to 'edit' if date entered is before 'Date Dictated'
269d97b7: Quit
bd649899: If X is not blank, set input transform to validate dates, call DGJTSTOR^DGJPXREF to perform mumps cross-references, and quit or branch to label A based on value of Y
d200916b: If X is blank, set DGJTST to 'TRANSCRIBED' and Y to '@2'
38b67c36: Quit
b0192e35: Call DIE update logic if DG array defined, then branch to ^DGJXA14
